subject: The confession that stopped me cold last week
preview_text: A user sent me something I wasn't expecting. It changes how you should use the app. Here's the truth.
body_paragraphs: I was checking support messages last Tuesday when one stopped my scrolling cold. The subject line was just 'Thank you.' But the first sentence hit me like a gut punch.

She wrote: 'I used the AI therapist last night to talk about my ex. For the first time, I didn't ask how to get him back. I asked how to stop wanting him back.' She described the exact moment her healing switched from looking backward to looking forward. It wasn't a dramatic breakthrough. It was a quiet realization in a 3AM session that she deserved better than begging for scraps.

That's why the 'Custom Coping Strategies' feature exists. It's not just generic advice. It analyzes your specific breakup patterns—the 'why I keep going back' thoughts—and builds a personal playbook for the exact moment your brain tries to betray you. It's built for that switch.

Open the app. Go to 'Coping Strategies' now. Tell it one pattern you want to break. Let it build your exit plan. P.S. Her final line to me: 'I finally used it to build a future, not replay the past.' That's the secret.
